sections.Profile:
The "Super Mario Bros. Mushroom World" pinball machine, manufactured by Gottlieb in 1992, is a notable entry in the pinball world due to its unique theme and gameplay, as well as being a redemption game. Designed by Ray Tanzer with artwork by David Moore, Constantino Mitchell, and Jeanine Mitchell, this machine features iconic characters and elements from the Super Mario franchise, specifically focusing on Super Mario Bros. 3.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1992

- Type: Solid State
